children.name: text-2
children.text: At the end of the lesson, pupils should be able to:

children.name: text-2
children.text: Plants are fascinating living organisms that come in a variety of sizes. They grow from soil and use the Sun's energy to produce food. Every part of the plant serves an important purpose.

children.name: text-1
children.text: WHAT ARE THE DIFFERENT TYPES OF PLANT

children.name: text-2
children.text: Roots are usually underground. It anchors the plant in the ground. Roots absorb water and minerals from the soil.

children.name: text-2
children.text: The stem supports leaves and flowers. It allows food and water to go around the plant.

children.name: text-2
children.text: Leaves are flat and thin parts of the plant. It uses the sun to make its food. Most leaves are green in color.

children.name: text-2
children.text: The flower is considered the most attractive part of the plant.

children.name: text-2
children.text: A seed is a part that can grow into a new plant. Most plants reproduce by seeds.
